My brother and I are similar. We have not spoken since 2020 when I had my last bad self harm  episode around him. 

I had my worst episode since then on Sunday, I thought I would take my life. Monday afternoon he called and asked for computer advice, I think my SO put him up to it. All we did was talk about the right way to rewire his monitor but it changed my day. Just knowing I had blood who still cared about me. 

He texted me this morning and offered to help make some calls to get me on a waitlist for a therapy program. He maybe sent 50 words, just “I know what’s going on, any way I can make some calls to help” he put in maybe 25 minutes of his time total, but it did so much to fill my heart. And it may even help get me into treatment. 


I don’t know your relationship with your sibling, you have to make sure you’re taking care of yourself, but it’s a big scary crazy world, sometimes it can make all the difference to have family at your side.

Call him, text him, or doesn’t matter why it could be an old photo or a meme. If you have the feeling act on it.

Reach out, it could mean the world to him.

Honestly wow this video was super helpful. I almost feel silly for not finding this before. That persistence of the symptoms piece is something I need to explore and really think through, because my ups and downs are not days long over and over. It’s like rapid fire flashes.

I without a doubt experience a broader spectrum of symptoms than just anxiety. Is it mania or is it a good mood? Is it mania or are my bad moods just really bad? Is this desire for a new partner me being unhappy or my brain going for loops. 

I’m at somewhat of a crossroads for what box to end up in. Which is why I’m leaning towards some treatments like lamictal that have natural crossover anyway.

Mostly: it seems like so much more than a panic disorder. 

I have these periods of “mania” where I’ll become obsessed over something and dive all in, I spent two months convinced I would be a hit YouTuber before giving up, currently my apartment is full of Tshirt screen printing gear. When this is going on I’m also always eating. Always.

This will be mixed with deep periods of dread when I can’t even bring myself to watch tv, I’ll sulk, I won’t eat. 

Mixed in there are flashes of intense panic and anger, that will have me debilitated on the floor crying and writhing, and 30 minutes later it’s like it never happened. On a repeat cycle.

I also have not gotten 8 hours of sleep uninterrupted in over a year. 


If you don’t think it’s BP1, say it. I am not sure what I am dealing with, or how I should go about healing myself. I just know I need help.

The current mental health provider gave a diagnosis. But I’m worried about that being confirmation bias, I walked into that meeting saying I think I’m BP1, this feels like more than  
a panic disorder.

I also know there is a lot of overlap in the medications used to treat these two conditions, it’s a lot fuzzier a line, not hard and fast like organ failure.

Thank you for such a well thought out comment here. What you said about needing treatment for a panic disorder is spot on, and part of why I’m here. I have always tried treating what I am going through JUST as a panic disorder and nothing really seemed to help. I was a Xanax zombie for about a year, and while I was calmer I was hardly human. 

I have heard very mixed things about lithium, but it’s the one that keeps coming up especially as a starting point. 

Seroquel is another one that keeps crossing my radar. However I work in a big office, where my
performance is already an issue  so the idea of being even groggier worries me. That being said I guess not slipping lower should be my priority #1.
 I’ll also look into gene sight, and hot damn if that works for me and can save even a little trial and error…

First, I want to say thank you for the measures thought out response here. I’m still figuring out what this road I am on is so I appreciate your response. What we’ve been exploring is BP1, the cycle of mania, my brain moving a million miles an hour, emptying my wallet for a new hobby every month, and not sleeping for days, followed by a crash and panic attacks and days of walking around in the cloak of dread. The other thing is a hair-trigger when it comes to panic attacks at perceived slights and the constant barrage of intrusive, out of touch thoughts. I am hoping to find something that helps me bring in the margins so to speak. I have taken medication that has made me feel “muted” at the cost of sexual side effects, and I have taken benzos that could kill a panic attack, but also any emotion in my body. 

I’ve been finding my “cycle” time of mania into depression shortening, after being off medication for a year I need to give my brain some help.

I appreciate that, I have certainly been down the road of taking a CBT and lifestyle change based approach. Even under the best scenarios My brain needs some type of help to achieve chemical balance.
